english_title: Properties of the Trace of a Linear Operator
statement_en: For linear operators $\mathscr{A},\mathscr{B}$, the trace satisfies: 1. $$\text{trace}(\mathscr{A}\circ \mathscr{B})=\text{trace}(\mathscr{B}\circ \mathscr{A}).$$ 2. $$\text{trace}(a\mathscr{A}+b\mathscr{B})=a\,\text{trace}(\mathscr{A})+b\,\text{trace}(\mathscr{B}),$$ where $a,b$ are constants.
callout_body:
1. 算子交换迹不变：$$\text{trace}(\mathscr{A}\circ \mathscr{B})=\text{trace}(\mathscr{B}\circ \mathscr{A})$$
2. 算子的迹矩阵是线性的:$$\text{trace}(a\mathscr{A}+b\mathscr{B})=a \,\text{trace}(\mathscr{A})+b \,\text{trace}(\mathscr{A})$$其中$a,b$是两个常数。
